name: ChatGPT
description: Open ChatGPT’s regular web interface. Compare a public practice answer with a terminal-based workflow.

name: Claude
description: Use Claude in the browser. This is separate from opening Claude Code in your project folder.

name: Gemini
description: Open Google’s Gemini web interface. Use a dedicated learning account, not a government Google account.

name: Grok
description: Open Grok’s chat website. Website sign-in is separate from the Grok terminal tool’s configuration.

name: Microsoft Copilot
description: The public Copilot website—not GitHub Copilot CLI or a government Microsoft 365 workspace. Do not use a government account.

name: Perplexity
description: Try a public question in another web interface. Independently check the answer and any linked evidence.

name: Mistral Vibe Chat
description: Mistral’s web chat, formerly Le Chat. A model provider offering open weights does not make this hosted website local.
